question: For The Estee Lauder Companies (fiscal year ends June 30), report GAAP gross margin (gross profit / net sales, in %) and GAAP operating margin (operating income (loss) / net sales, in %) for each of its last four reported fiscal quarters as of October 3, 2026. Label each quarter with its fiscal quarter, fiscal year and period-end date. Use GAAP figures as reported (not adjusted/non-GAAP); fourth-quarter results are not separately filed on a 10-Q.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Estee Lauder GAAP margins (Q4 FY2026 derived as FY2026 minus nine months and matching the Q4 release):
| Row | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2026 (ended 2025-09-30) | 73.37% | 4.85% |
| Q2 FY2026 (ended 2025-12-31) | 76.50% | 9.48% |
| Q3 FY2026 (ended 2026-03-31) | 76.40% | 6.71% |
| Q4 FY2026 (ended 2026-06-30) | 75.46% | -1.08% |

output.answer:
# The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) — GAAP Margins, Last Four Reported Fiscal Quarters (as of Oct. 3, 2026)

All dollar figures in millions; margins calculated as GAAP gross profit ÷ net sales and GAAP operating (loss) income ÷ net sales, using figures as reported.

| Fiscal Quarter | Period-End Date | Net Sales | Gross Profit | **GAAP Gross Margin** | Operating Income (Loss) | **GAAP Operating Margin** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2026 | Sept. 30, 2025 | $3,481 | $2,554 | **73.4%** | $169 | **4.9%** |
| Q2 FY2026 | Dec. 31, 2025 | $4,229 | $3,235 | **76.5%** | $401 | **9.5%** |
| Q3 FY2026 | Mar. 31, 2026 | $3,712 | $2,836 | **76.4%** | $249 | **6.7%** |
| Q4 FY2026 | June 30, 2026 | $3,627 | $2,737 | **75.5%** | $(39) | **(1.1)%** |

**Notes on the figures:**
- Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 are the four most recent quarters (the company's fiscal year ends June 30; Q4/FY results are reported via an earnings release/8-K rather than a standalone 10-Q).
- Q1 FY2026 operating income of $169M / 4.9% margin reflects, among other items, talcum-litigation charge effects in the prior-year comparison.
- Q2 FY2026 operating income of $401M includes lower restructuring/impairment charges vs. the year-ago period (which had $861M of goodwill/intangible impairments).
- Q3 FY2026 operating income of approximately $249M (6.7% margin) was reduced by $224M restructuring and other charges plus an $84M loss contingency (net of estimated insurance recoveries) tied to a potential securities class-action settlement. (Derived as $2,836M gross profit − $2,279M SG&A − $224M restructuring − $84M contingency.)
- Q4 FY2026 operating loss of $(39)M (−1.1%) includes $293M of restructuring and other charges recorded in the quarter; GAAP net loss was $116M (−$0.32 per diluted share).

**Sources:**
- Q1 FY2026 (period ended Sept. 30, 2025): https://www.elcompanies.com/en/news-and-media/newsroom/press-releases/2025/10-30-2025-100022718
- Q2 FY2026 (period ended Dec. 31, 2025): https://www.elcompanies.com/en/news-and-media/newsroom/press-releases/2026/02-05-2026-110042358
- Q3 FY2026 (period ended Mar. 31, 2026): https://www.elcompanies.com/en/news-and-media/newsroom/press-releases/2026/05-01-2026-110042145 (10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1001250/000100125026000019/el-20260331.htm)
- Q4/FY2026 (period ended June 30, 2026): https://www.elcompanies.com/en/news-and-media/newsroom/press-releases/2026/08-19-2026-110037466 (SEC exhibit: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1001250/000100125026000038/elq4fy2026exhibit991.htm)
